context: ▶ Theorem 3. For every fixed reflexive non-bi-arc graph H, there exist a, b, c, such that the LHom(H) problem cannot be solved in time 2o(n) in n-vertex Sa,b,c -free graphs, unless the ETH fails. Unfortunately, we were not able to provide the full complexity dichotomy for Sa,b,c -free graphs. We conjecture that the distinction between “easy” and “hard” cases is as follows. ▶ Conjecture 4.
